claim_boundary: The 22 PhysTwin cases have already been opened and used for method development.
Results may diagnose observation quality and model-class headroom but cannot confirm a new method or support a state-of-the-art claim.
Manual sparse prefix identities are an observation-quality ceiling, not a deployable input.
Only observations through the permitted response prefix may update the rollout; future object observations are forbidden.
Manual tracks remain available after the prefix only for evaluation.

evaluator.graph_solver: preconditioned conjugate gradient with a residual-verified sparse-direct fallback on iteration-cap or nonfinite failure

manual_sparse_prefix_ceiling.role: reproduce the previously observed manual-identity headroom and identify causal versus future-open candidates

automatic_cotracker3_multiview.role: deployable causal observation arm frozen before its 22-case outcomes

primary_diagnostics: case wins against the selected physical baseline
published 8 mm Chamfer and 15 mm track thresholds as context only

interpretation_rule.automatic_joint_threshold_pass: justify a new preregistered evaluation on genuinely fresh objects after merging every hash-only object exclusion manifest
interpretation_rule.automatic_improves_but_misses_threshold: treat automatic material-identity acquisition as the remaining bottleneck and improve it only with source-only evidence
interpretation_rule.automatic_regresses: stop threshold tuning on the opened cohort and require an independent modality or separately trained source-only identity observer
